events.title: The Double Life Of Veronique
events.location: Nimbin Bush Theatre, 2 Blue Knob Road Nimbin NSW 2480
events.description: Two women, born on the same day in different countries, live separate lives yet share an inexplicable emotional connection. Weronika is a young Polish singer with an extraordinary voice; Véronique is a French music teacher who begins to sense that somewhere, somehow, she has never been entirely alone.

events.title: Cacao Ceremony
events.location: Nimbin Bush Theatre, 2 Blue Knob Road Nimbin NSW 2480
events.description: Join Lisa for a transformative cacao ceremony that nurtures the heart and soul. Experience the magic of ceremonial cacao, guided meditation, and intention-setting in a sacred, welcoming space. Immerse yourself in ambient music by Michael Skinner as you connect deeply with yourself and the moment. Let this ceremony be a time for reflection, healing, and opening to new possibilities.

events.title: Stop Making Sense
events.location: Nimbin Bush Theatre, 2 Blue Knob Road Nimbin NSW 2480
events.description: David Byrne walks onto an empty stage carrying a guitar and a cassette player. “Hi, I’ve got a tape I want to play.” From that wonderfully simple beginning, Stop Making Sense gradually builds into one of the most exhilarating concert films ever made.

events.title: Nourishing Yin Yoga and Sound Healing
events.location: Nimbin Bush Theatre, 2 Blue Knob Road Nimbin NSW 2480
events.description: Immerse yourself in a morning of deep relaxation and rejuvenation at the Nimbin Bush Theatre with Nourishing Yin Yoga with Chrissy followed by a transformative Crystal Bowl Sound Bath with Karolynka. Let Chrissy guide you through gentle yin yoga postures designed to restore balance, release tension, and nourish your body and soul while being enveloped by the ethereal sounds of Armandine's crystal bowls, creating vibrational harmony that soothes the mind and spirit. Set against the serene backdrop of the Nimbin Bush Theatre, this unique experience is the perfect way to unwind, reconnect, and recharge. Don't miss this magical journey of sound and stillness!
